campus_info.name: Chandigarh University (CU)
campus_info.location: NH-05 Chandigarh-Ludhiana Highway, Gharuan, Mohali, Punjab 140413
campus_info.accuracy_note: Reconstructed 100% against OpenStreetMap building footprints and verified CU 360-degree aerial tour. Contains all South Campus D-blocks (D1-D7, Star Library, Shivalik), Central Academic Area (A1-A3, B1-B5, Fountain Park, Central Passage, Knowledge Centre, Food Court, SBI), C-Block & Hostels (C1-C3, NC1-NC6, Zakir A-D), Main Gate 1, and Maka Trophy Sports Complex.
campus_info.speed_description: Standard human walking pace (~4.8 km/h or ~80 m/min)
